brief: Reduce the permissible load in proportion to the lost cooling capacity by applying an 8 percent reduction because one of three cooling fans has seized, and combine this with any applicable ambient de-rating as specified in MG-021. For the light oil film on the bund floor consistent with a slow leak, the supplied documents do not cover the situation. Apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure as directed in MG-023.
